sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: By the late 1980s, AIDS had been in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪80年代末，艾滋病在美国

sentences.en: for almost a decade.
sentences.zh: 已经肆虐了近十年。

sentences.en: If you look through timelines from this period, you see the records of 100 people dead,
sentences.zh: 如果你翻看这一时期的历史时间线，你会看到100人死亡的记录，

sentences.en: 1,000 people dead, a million people dead.
sentences.zh: 1000人死亡，一百万人死亡。

sentences.en: AIDS becomes the number one killer of young men in New York City,
sentences.zh: 艾滋病成为纽约市年轻男性的头号杀手，

sentences.en: then of young men in the country, then of young men and women in the country.
sentences.zh: 然后是全美年轻男性，接着是全美的年轻男女。

sentences.en: But what you don't see much of in the late 80s is public acknowledgement of AIDS.
sentences.zh: 但在80年代末，你很难看到对艾滋病的公开承认。

sentences.en: That's reporter Audrey Quinn.
sentences.zh: 那是记者奥黛丽·奎因。

sentences.en: Millions of people were dying of this mysterious new disease,
sentences.zh: 数百万人死于这种神秘的新疾病，

sentences.en: but there was so much stigma against talking about it.
sentences.zh: 但谈论它的社会污名太重了。

sentences.en: You kind of felt like you were living in a war zone and there was no reporting.
sentences.zh: 你感觉自己好像生活在一个战区，却没有任何报道。

sentences.en: It was a bizarro world.
sentences.zh: 这是一个光怪陆离的世界。

sentences.en: That's Patrick O'Connell.
sentences.zh: 那是帕特里克·奥康奈尔。

sentences.en: He was really involved with the Manhattan art scene in the late 80s,
sentences.zh: 他深度参与了80年代末的曼哈顿艺术界，

sentences.en: a community where it could be hard to think about anything but the AIDS crisis.
sentences.zh: 在这个社群里，除了艾滋病危机，你很难去想别的什么。

sentences.en: We would spend days going to St. Vincent's to visit someone,
sentences.zh: 我们会花几天时间去圣文森特医院探望某人，

sentences.en: going to Redden's for a funeral, and then getting on your answering machine
sentences.zh: 去雷登殡仪馆参加葬礼，然后接听你的答录机，

sentences.en: a message of somebody flipping out because they've just been told
sentences.zh: 里面留着某个人的疯狂留言，因为他们刚刚被告知

sentences.en: that they're going to be sick or are sick.
sentences.zh: 他们将要生病或者已经生病了。

sentences.en: So Patrick and a group of other artists turned their focus to AIDS.
sentences.zh: 于是帕特里克和其他几位艺术家将他们的注意力转向了艾滋病。

sentences.en: Yeah, why were you making art in response to AIDS?
sentences.zh: 是的，你们为什么要创作艺术来回应艾滋病？

sentences.en: Actually, I don't understand that question.
sentences.zh: 其实，我不明白这个问题。

sentences.en: How could you not be?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能不这么做呢？

sentences.en: In 1988, O'Connell and his collaborators began calling their collective Visual Aids.
sentences.zh: 1988年，奥康奈尔和他的合作者开始将他们的集体称为“视觉艾滋”。

sentences.en: They held public events to raise AIDS awareness.
sentences.zh: 他们举办公开活动来提高人们对艾滋病的认识。

sentences.en: There were slideshows, gallery shows.
sentences.zh: 有幻灯片放映，有画廊展览。

sentences.en: But of all the work they did, the thing that had the biggest effect was a simple little symbol
sentences.zh: 但在他们所做的一切工作中，产生最大影响的是一个简单的小标志，

sentences.en: that, at the time, was a novel concept, the AIDS awareness ribbon.
sentences.zh: 在当时这是一个新颖的概念，即艾滋病关怀红丝带。

sentences.en: It all started one night in the spring of 1991.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于1991年春的一个晚上。

sentences.en: The Visual Aids Artist Caucus held a meeting in search of a symbol.
sentences.zh: “视觉艾滋”艺术家核心小组举行了一次会议，寻找一个标志。

sentences.en: They wanted something that could be created, that could be put out there for people to wear.
sentences.zh: 他们想要某种可以被创造出来、可以推广让人们佩戴的东西。

sentences.en: That's Mark Hopple.
sentences.zh: 那是马克·霍普尔。

sentences.en: He's a costume designer and was at that meeting.
sentences.zh: 他是一名服装设计师，当时也出席了那场会议。

sentences.en: He's now director of costumes for the New York City Ballet.
sentences.zh: 他现在是纽约市芭蕾舞团的服装总监。

sentences.en: Back then, he and friends had been doing a lot of driving around upstate New York.
sentences.zh: 当年，他和朋友们经常开车去纽约州北部转悠。

sentences.en: This was at the time of the Persian Gulf War.
sentences.zh: 那是波斯湾战争时期。

sentences.en: We started to see, of course, at the time, yellow ribbons that were tied around trees,
sentences.zh: 当然，我们当时开始看到树上系着黄丝带，

sentences.en: which is, you know, in reference to that song for servicemen.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那是为了呼应那首献给军人的歌。

sentences.en: You know, we just were like, hmm, you know, why couldn't we do something like that for AIDS?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们当时就在想，嗯，为什么我们不能为艾滋病做点类似的事情呢？

sentences.en: And we talked about, you know, would it really be around a tree?
sentences.zh: 我们讨论过，你知道的，真的要系在树上吗？

sentences.en: And that just seemed a little like, I don't know, not right.
sentences.zh: 那似乎有点，我不知道，不太对劲。

sentences.en: Then it became like, oh, maybe not around the tree, but maybe folded with a pin on your lapel.
sentences.zh: 然后演变成，哦，也许不是系在树上，而是折叠起来用胸针别在翻领上。

sentences.en: Then it was time to pick a color.
sentences.zh: 接着是挑选颜色的时间。

sentences.en: In the meeting, it also came about that it was like, yes, it should be red because it represents blood.
sentences.zh: 在会议上，大家也达成了一致，觉得应该是红色的，因为它代表血液。

sentences.en: It was just so obviously right.
sentences.zh: 这实在是太理所当然了。

sentences.en: A local ribbon supplier donated spools of half-inch wide red grosgrain ribbon.
sentences.zh: 一家当地的丝带供应商捐赠了一卷卷半英寸宽的红色罗缎。

sentences.en: Grosgrain's that ribbed ribbon you might have worn around your ponytail growing up.
sentences.zh: 罗缎就是你从小扎马尾辫时可能戴过的那种带棱纹的丝带。

sentences.en: And we started just in these meetings, like folding them and doing different things with them.
sentences.zh: 我们开始在这些会议上，把它们折叠起来，用它们做各种尝试。

sentences.en: And first it just started out just like folding it in half.
sentences.zh: 一开始只是像对折那样。

sentences.en: But then it came to actually folding it in that way we now know it so well with a safety pin.
sentences.zh: 但后来真正折成了我们现在熟知的、用别针别著的那个形状。

sentences.en: The looped, inverted V-shape.
sentences.zh: 那个环状的、倒V字形。

sentences.en: We were on the streets of the city within 10 weeks or something with them.
sentences.zh: 大约10周左右，我们就带着它们走上了城市的街头。

sentences.en: Patrick O'Connell again.
sentences.zh: 又是帕特里克·奥康奈尔。

sentences.en: By this time, he was director of Visual Aids.
sentences.zh: 此时，他已是“视觉艾滋”的负责人。

sentences.en: And at this point, the red ribbons were essentially an art project.
sentences.zh: 而在这个阶段，红丝带本质上还是一个艺术项目。

sentences.en: The Visual Aids Artist Caucus members held what they called ribbon bees.
sentences.zh: “视觉艾滋”艺术家核心小组成员举办了他们所说的“丝带聚会”。

sentences.en: Think like a quilting bee, a bunch of people gathered to work.
sentences.zh: 就像拼布聚会一样，一群人聚在一起工作。

sentences.en: They'd hand cut, fold, and pin thousands of ribbons, all just to hand out for free.
sentences.zh: 他们手工裁剪、折叠并用别针别好数千条丝带，全部免费分发。

sentences.en: In mid-May, I had this very foolish idea that we should be on the Tony Awards.
sentences.zh: 在5月中旬，我产生了一个非常愚蠢的想法，觉得我们应该登上托尼奖的舞台。

sentences.en: Which left us approximately two weeks to achieve this.
sentences.zh: 这留给我们大约两周的时间来实现这一点。

sentences.en: You know, convince everybody that this was not going to be disruptive, but rather something they should embrace.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，要说服所有人这不会具有颠覆性，而是他们应该欣然接受的事物。

sentences.en: A number of Visual Aids members had Broadway connections.
sentences.zh: 许多“视觉艾滋”成员都有百老汇的人脉。

sentences.en: They haggled with the organizers of the Tony Awards and coaxed celebrity dressers into pinning the ribbons on their clients before the ceremony.
sentences.zh: 他们与托尼奖组织者讨价还价，并哄劝明星造型师在颁奖典礼前将丝带别在客户的翻领上。

sentences.en: And they got to work making new ribbons.
sentences.zh: 然后他们开始制作新的丝带。

sentences.en: Mark Hopple's studio was mad.
sentences.zh: 马克·霍普尔的工作室简直疯狂。

sentences.en: It was fabulous.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: We were distributing the more typically sized ribbons.
sentences.zh: 我们在分发常规尺寸的丝带。

sentences.en: But we thought, oh, we're going to ruin everybody's dress and dinner jacket.
sentences.zh: 但我们想，哦，我们会弄坏所有人的礼服和晚礼服。

sentences.en: So let's make them big and specific for the presenters.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们为颁奖嘉宾制作大号且特殊的丝带。

sentences.en: So the camera could like really capture them.
sentences.zh: 这样镜头就能真正捕捉到它们。

sentences.en: The night of the show came.
sentences.zh: 颁奖之夜来临了。

sentences.en: June 7th, 1991.
That night we all kind of went home and everybody was crossing their fingers because we didn't know.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上我们都回家了，每个人都在祈祷，因为我们不知道结果。

sentences.en: They didn't know if anyone would actually wear the ribbons.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道是否真的有人会佩戴这些丝带。

sentences.en: I mean, we handed all this stuff out and all these wardrobe supervisors and all these dressers are new.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们把这些东西都分发了，所有的服装主管和造型师都是新接触这个。

sentences.en: They said, sure, we'll see what we can do.
sentences.zh: 他们说，当然，我们会看看能做些什么。

sentences.en: Can't promise much, but we'll try.
sentences.zh: 不能保证太多，但我们会试试。

sentences.en: Tonight, live from the Minskoff Theatre on Broadway, the 1991 Tony Awards.
sentences.zh: 今晚，从百老汇明斯考夫剧院现场直播，1991年托尼奖。

sentences.en: Hosted by this year's Academy Award winner, a former Tony Award winner, Mr. Jeremy Irons.
sentences.zh: 由今年的奥斯卡奖得主、前托尼奖得主杰瑞米·艾恩斯先生主持。

sentences.en: And Jeremy Irons walked out with a red ribbon on his lapel.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞米·艾恩斯走出来时，翻领上别着一条红丝带。

sentences.en: The fact that he walked out wearing it was the most brilliant thing.
sentences.zh: 他佩戴着它走出来这一事实，简直是最棒的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm emotional now because it was like, wow, you know, it worked.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我现在都很激动，因为那感觉就像是，哇，你知道的，成功了。

sentences.en: I found the full show on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 我在YouTube上找到了完整的颁奖典礼。

sentences.en: Jeremy Irons is so handsome.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞米·艾恩斯太帅了。

sentences.en: This slicked back hair and a big red ribbon on the left lapel of his black tux.
sentences.zh: 他梳着大背头，黑色燕尾服的左翻领上别着一条巨大的红丝带。

sentences.en: The first winner of the night's this little girl, Daisy Egan, star of The Secret Garden.
sentences.zh: 当晚的第一位获奖者是这个小女孩，黛西·埃根，《秘密花园》的主演。

sentences.en: I don't think I can talk.
sentences.zh: 我想我都说不出话来了。

sentences.en: She's got this poofy-sleeved black-and-white dress on and a little red ribbon on her cheSt.
sentences.zh: 她穿着一件泡泡袖黑白连衣裙，胸前别着一条小红丝带。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们。

sentences.en: Then there's Kevin Spacey.
sentences.zh: 接着是凯文·史派西。

sentences.en: Kevin Spacey, lost in Yonkers.
sentences.zh: 凯文·史派西，凭借《阳光男孩》获奖。

sentences.en: He goes up to accept his award with a more medium-sized red ribbon.
sentences.zh: 他上台领奖时，佩戴了一条中等尺寸的红丝带。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Next, you see Penn and Teller wearing big red ribbons.
sentences.zh: 接下来，你看到彭恩和特勒戴着巨大的红丝带。

sentences.en: By the end of the show, I was paying more attention to the presenters not wearing ribbons,
sentences.zh: 到节目结束时，我开始更多地关注那些没有佩戴丝带的颁奖嘉宾，

sentences.en: totally judging them for missing the memo.
sentences.zh: 在心里狠狠吐槽他们错过了通知。

sentences.en: What you also notice watching the Tonys is how new the awareness ribbon was.
sentences.zh: 看托尼奖时你还会注意到，关怀红丝带当时是多么新颖的事物。

sentences.en: Everyone was wearing them in different ways.
sentences.zh: 每个人佩戴它们的方式都不一样。

sentences.en: Some were looped.
sentences.zh: 有些是环状的。

sentences.en: Some were folded in sharp angles.
sentences.zh: 有些折成了锐角。

sentences.en: Some of the ribbons have their ends spread wide like wings.
sentences.zh: 有些丝带的两端像翅膀一样张开。

sentences.en: But here's the crucial thing.
sentences.zh: 但最关键的是这个。

sentences.en: No one explained the ribbons on air.
sentences.zh: 没有人真正在直播中解释这些丝带是什么。

sentences.en: Rumor has it the network threatened to go to commercial break if they did.
sentences.zh: 有传言称，如果他们这么做了，电视台威胁要插播商业广告。

sentences.en: Turns out this degree of mystery provided some incredibly good press.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这种程度的神秘感带来了极其出色的宣传效果。

sentences.en: The one thing that was kind of exciting is the next day,
sentences.zh: 有一点挺让人兴奋的，那就是第二天，

sentences.en: there was a little blurb in the newspaper that was like,
sentences.zh: 报纸上出现了一则小短讯，内容类似于：

sentences.en: what was that red ribbon?
sentences.zh: 那条红丝带是什么？

sentences.en: And it was everywhere at the Tony Awards.
sentences.zh: 它在托尼奖上无处不在。

sentences.en: There was two days of print media wondering what this red ribbon was.
sentences.zh: 平面媒体花了两天时间猜测这条红丝带究竟是什么。

sentences.en: So, you know, that really, I think for us and for the red ribbon itself,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，这真的，我认为对我们以及红丝带本身而言，

sentences.en: was just the point where it just exploded.
sentences.zh: 正是它彻底爆发的转折点。

sentences.en: Within days, the ribbon was stopping traffic.
sentences.zh: 几天之内，红丝带就引起了轰动。

sentences.en: We ran into this seemingly very successful businessman and his wife on the streets.
sentences.zh: 我们在街上遇到了一个看起来非常成功的商人夫妇。

sentences.en: And he saw us wearing our red ribbon and he was like,
sentences.zh: 他看到我们佩戴着红丝带，就对我们说：

sentences.en: I saw that.
sentences.zh: 我看到了。

sentences.en: I saw that on the Tonys.
sentences.zh: 我在托尼奖上看到了那个。

sentences.en: And he's like, that's about AIDS, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 他说，那是关于艾滋病的，对吧？

sentences.en: Isn't it?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: That's about AIDS because no one actually said it.
sentences.zh: 那是关于艾滋病的，因为当时根本没人明说。

sentences.en: And I said, well, yes.
sentences.zh: 我说，嗯，是的。

sentences.en: And he's like, how did you get one?
sentences.zh: 他说，你们是怎么弄到一个的？

sentences.en: I said, well, actually, we made them.
sentences.zh: 我说，其实，是我们自己做的。

sentences.en: It's our project.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的项目。

sentences.en: And he peeled off a hundred dollar bill and gave it to us.
sentences.zh: 他掏出一张一百美元的钞票递给了我们。

sentences.en: When they found out what it was for,
sentences.zh: 当他们发现这是为了什么时，

sentences.en: I think a lot of people really got on board and just were like,
sentences.zh: 我想很多人真的都加入了进来，并且觉得：

sentences.en: I need to start wearing a red ribbon.
sentences.zh: 我也得开始佩戴红丝带了。

sentences.en: And it just really pushed it over into being kind of almost a, you know,
sentences.zh: 这真的把它推向了几乎可以说是，你知道的，

sentences.en: just a much bigger symbol than it ever had been.
sentences.zh: 变成了一个远比以往任何时候都更宏大的符号。

sentences.en: And I think that we ever really thought it might be so quickly.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们从未想过它能如此迅速达到的高度。

sentences.en: The next stop for the ribbon was the Emmys, then the Oscars and the Grammy Awards.
sentences.zh: 丝带的下一站是艾美奖，然后是奥斯卡奖和格莱美奖。

sentences.en: And the members of visual aids continue to gather to make them.
sentences.zh: 而“视觉艾滋”的成员们继续聚集在一起制作它们。

sentences.en: Cut, fold, and pin.
sentences.zh: 裁剪、折叠并用别针别好。

sentences.en: We would be watching on TV famous people wear our ribbons
sentences.zh: 我们会一边在电视上看着名人佩戴我们的丝带，

sentences.en: while we sat in the loft making ribbons together.
sentences.zh: 一边坐在阁楼里一起制作丝带。

sentences.en: Very meta, as they now say.
sentences.zh: 正如他们现在所说的那样，非常具有元叙事色彩。

sentences.en: In those days, we would have said it would have been very Pomo.
sentences.zh: 在那个年代，我们大概会说这非常后现代。

sentences.en: School groups and church groups started contacting the visual aids artists,
sentences.zh: 学校团体和教会团体开始联系“视觉艾滋”艺术家，

sentences.en: asking how they could start their own ribbon project.
sentences.zh: 询问他们如何才能发起自己的丝带项目。

sentences.en: And it just becomes this phenomenon, which we were surprised by.
sentences.zh: 它就这样变成了一种现象，这让我们感到意外。

sentences.en: When did it start to feel like the ribbon was out of your hands,
sentences.zh: 什么时候你开始觉得红丝带已经脱离了你们的掌控，

sentences.en: like it was no longer a visual aids thing?
sentences.zh: 感觉它不再仅仅是“视觉艾滋”的东西了？

sentences.en: Well, probably by 90, the end of 92,
sentences.zh: 嗯，大概在90年，92年底的时候，

sentences.en: in terms of the introduction of like, you know,
sentences.zh: 从诸如，你知道的，

sentences.en: the bejeweled leathern back, crystal pave, red ribbon, etc.
sentences.zh: 珠宝镶嵌皮革背面、水晶密镶红丝带等事物的出现开始。

sentences.en: There were red ribbon diamond necklaces,
sentences.zh: 出现了红丝带钻石项链，

sentences.en: red ribbon Christmas ornaments, red ribbon t-shirts.
sentences.zh: 红丝带圣诞装饰品，红丝带T恤。

sentences.en: There were some of us that thought that visual aids should trademark it.
sentences.zh: 我们当中有些人曾认为，Visual AIDS 组织应该为它注册商标。

sentences.en: And so that anytime it's used, the money had to come back to visual aids.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，无论何时使用它，资金都必须回流给 Visual AIDS。

sentences.en: One of the reasons we didn't was that it would not have been embraced
sentences.zh: 我们没有这么做的原因之一是，如果这样做的话，

sentences.en: so willingly and so universally if we had.
sentences.zh: 它就不会被如此自愿且普遍地接受了。

sentences.en: If everyone had to come and say,
sentences.zh: 如果每个人都必须跑来问：

sentences.en: may I have permission to do this?
sentences.zh: 我能获得这样做的许可吗？

sentences.en: It would have been in contrast to the spirit of the artwork.
sentences.zh: 这就违背了这件艺术品的精神。

sentences.en: So yeah, I mean, do I wish visual aids had a nickel for every ribbon peddled in the world
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我是说，我难道不希望 Visual AIDS 能从世界上兜售的每一条丝带或

sentences.en: or ribbon object?
sentences.zh: 每一个丝带衍生品中抽成五美分吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That's after the fact.
sentences.zh: 但那是后话了。

sentences.en: The ribbon's creators felt a backlash from other aids activists.
sentences.zh: 红丝带的创造者们感受到了来自其他艾滋病活动人士的强烈反弹。

sentences.en: At first, just wearing the ribbon felt like a radical act,
sentences.zh: 起初，仅仅是佩戴红丝带就像是一种激进的举动，

sentences.en: publicly acknowledging that aids existed,
sentences.zh: 公开承认艾滋病的存在，

sentences.en: that people were suffering, that you cared.
sentences.zh: 承认人们在受苦，承认你在乎。

sentences.en: But as the ribbon became more ubiquitous,
sentences.zh: 但随着红丝带变得越来越无处不在，

sentences.en: some activists called wearing it an easy out,
sentences.zh: 一些活动人士称佩戴它是一种轻易的解脱，

sentences.en: a way to look like you cared about people with aids
sentences.zh: 是一种假装你关心艾滋病患者的方式，

sentences.en: without actually doing anything to help people with aids.
sentences.zh: 而实际上并没有为帮助艾滋病患者做任何事情。

sentences.en: Basically the same criticisms that met the Livestrong bracelet
sentences.zh: 基本上就是当年对待 Livestrong 腕带

sentences.en: and the ice bucket challenge.
sentences.zh: 和冰桶挑战的那些批评。

sentences.en: But Mark Hopple says that's okay.
sentences.zh: 但马克·霍普尔说这没关系。

sentences.en: What we wanted to do was create something that a mother in Michigan
sentences.zh: 我们想做的是创造出这样一种东西：密歇根州的一位母亲

sentences.en: could wear on the lapel of her blouse.
sentences.zh: 可以把它戴在衬衫的翻领上。

sentences.en: And she, you know, maybe her son was living in New York and living with aids
sentences.zh: 而她，你知道的，也许她的儿子住在纽约，身患艾滋病，

sentences.en: and she wanted to do something.
sentences.zh: 她想做点什么。

sentences.en: I think it was just, it was also a symbol that we created that somebody could wear
sentences.zh: 我想这只是，这也是我们创造的一个象征，任何人都可以佩戴它，

sentences.en: and somebody might go up to them and say,
sentences.zh: 然后可能会有人走到他们面前问：

sentences.en: what is that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: Why are you wearing that red ribbon?
sentences.zh: 你为什么戴着那条红丝带？

sentences.en: And hopefully that person would say, here's why.
sentences.zh: 而希望那个人会回答：原因在这里。

sentences.en: The ribbon was doing its job.
sentences.zh: 这条丝带正在发挥它的作用。

sentences.en: People were talking about aids.
sentences.zh: 人们在谈论艾滋病。

sentences.en: The New York Times declared 1992 the year of the ribbon.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》宣布 1992 年为“丝带年”。

sentences.en: President Clinton set up the White House Office of National AIDS Policy.
sentences.zh: 克林顿总统成立了白宫国家艾滋病政策办公室。

sentences.en: The National Institute of Health expanded its AIDS research.
sentences.zh: 美国国家卫生研究院扩大了其艾滋病研究。

sentences.en: And the government funded the National HIV Epidemiology Study.
sentences.zh: 政府还资助了国家艾滋病流行病学研究。

sentences.en: Over time, the awareness ribbon has gotten so much attention for aids
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，意识丝带为艾滋病获得了如此多的关注，

sentences.en: that more than 200 other causes, by our last count,
sentences.zh: 据我们最后统计，现在有 200 多个其他的公益事业

sentences.en: now use a looped awareness ribbon as their symbol.
sentences.zh: 都在使用打着圈的意识丝带作为他们的象征。

sentences.en: Well, it's interesting that almost 25 years later,
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，将近 25 年后，

sentences.en: it's everywhere now in everybody's face in different colors.
sentences.zh: 它现在无处不在，以不同的颜色出现在每个人的眼前。

sentences.en: There's the pink ribbon for breast cancer awareness,
sentences.zh: 有用于乳腺癌意识的粉红丝带，

sentences.en: an indigo ribbon for bullying awareness,
sentences.zh: 用于反霸凌意识的靛蓝丝带，

sentences.en: a teal ribbon for anxiety disorder awareness.
sentences.zh: 用于焦虑症意识的蓝绿色丝带。

sentences.en: Actually, the teal ribbon is also used for ovarian cancer awareness,
sentences.zh: 事实上，这种蓝绿色丝带也被用于卵巢癌意识、

sentences.en: Tourette's Syndrome awareness, Tsunami Victim Awareness.
sentences.zh: 图雷特综合征意识、海啸受害者意识。

sentences.en: There are more causes that want ribbons than there are colors of ribbon.
sentences.zh: 想要丝带的公益事业比丝带的颜色还要多。

sentences.en: And the ribbon's ubiquity eventually reached the point of parody.
sentences.zh: 而且丝带的无处不在最终达到了被恶搞的地步。

sentences.en: When the band Death Cab for Cutie wore light blue ribbons at the Grammys in 2009,
sentences.zh: 当乐队“死人为门帘”在 2009 年格莱美颁奖典礼上佩戴浅蓝色丝带时，

sentences.en: people wondered, was it about secondhand smoke awareness?
sentences.zh: 人们纷纷猜测，这是为了呼吁关注二手烟吗？

sentences.en: Or adrenocortical carcinoma awareness?
sentences.zh: 还是为了呼吁关注肾上腺皮质癌？

sentences.en: It turns out, Death Cab for Cutie had started their own cause,
sentences.zh: 事实证明，“死人为门帘”发起了他们自己的公益事业，

sentences.en: auto-tune abuse awareness.
sentences.zh: 即呼吁关注滥用自动调谐（Auto-Tune）现象。

sentences.en: You know, on 7th Avenue, you'd call that a knockoff.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在第七大道，你会称之为山寨货。

sentences.en: Elsewhere, you'd call it a ripoff.
sentences.zh: 换个地方，你就会称之为剽窃。

sentences.en: I think it's great that people took that simple little ribbon with a pin
sentences.zh: 我认为棒极了，人们拿着那枚带有别针的简简单单的小丝带，

sentences.en: and made it their own, you know,
sentences.zh: 把它变成他们自己的东西，你知道的，

sentences.en: and used it for whatever cause they were fighting.
sentences.zh: 并把它用于他们正在为之奋斗的任何事业。

sentences.en: I'm totally fine with that.
sentences.zh: 我完全不介意这一点。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, it's there for people to use
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你知道的，它是供人们使用的，

sentences.en: in whatever way they want to and however they want to get a message out.
sentences.zh: 无论他们以什么方式，或者想以什么方式传达信息。

sentences.en: I think the thing that really captures my imagination when I look at it
sentences.zh: 我认为当我看着它时，真正吸引我想象力的是，

sentences.en: is that it's such a perfect form.
sentences.zh: 它是如此完美的形态。

sentences.en: It's beautiful and economic in terms of its design.
sentences.zh: 从设计上来说，它既美观又经济。

sentences.en: And that is the best kind of design.
sentences.zh: 而这正是最好的设计。

sentences.en: That's Michelle Miller-Fisher.
sentences.zh: 那是米歇尔·米勒-费舍尔。

sentences.en: She's a curatorial assistant at the Architecture and Design Department
sentences.zh: 她是现代艺术博物馆（即 MoMA）

sentences.en: at the Museum of Modern Art, the MoMA.
sentences.zh: 建筑与设计部的策展助理。

sentences.en: In this last month, she helped make the red AIDS ribbon
sentences.zh: 就在上个月，她协助将红色的艾滋病丝带

sentences.en: an official part of the museum's collection.
sentences.zh: 正式纳入了该博物馆的收藏。

sentences.en: She remembers first seeing the ribbon as a kid in England in the 90s.
sentences.zh: 她还记得 90 年代在英国时，作为小孩子第一次看到这条丝带的情景。

sentences.en: The very first time I saw it, I realized that advocacy and passion,
sentences.zh: 我第一次看到它的时候，我意识到倡导与热情，

sentences.en: even understanding it as a very young child,
sentences.zh: 甚至作为一个非常小的孩子去理解它，

sentences.en: could be imbued in a very simple design.
sentences.zh: 都可以被注入到一个非常简单的设计中。

sentences.en: The MoMA has in its collection one of the hand-cut visual AIDS ribbons
sentences.zh: MoMA 的藏品中就有一枚手工剪裁的 Visual AIDS 丝带，

sentences.en: pinned to an original ribbon project handout explaining its meaning.
sentences.zh: 它别在解释其含义的原始丝带项目宣传单上。

sentences.en: I love the fact that I can see where someone has cut this.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢能看到有人亲手剪裁它的痕迹。

sentences.en: And so I wonder whether this was someone's 50th ribbon of the day
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇这究竟是某人当天剪的第 50 条丝带

sentences.en: or 100th ribbon of the day.
sentences.zh: 还是第 100 条丝带。

sentences.en: The MoMA plans to have the ribbon out on display in the next year.
sentences.zh: MoMA 计划在明年将这条丝带公开发布展示。

sentences.en: I will always think it's relevant.
sentences.zh: 我始终认为它具有现实意义。

sentences.en: Mark Harble again.
sentences.zh: 再次请出马克·哈伯。

sentences.en: Because, you know, AIDS is still with us.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，艾滋病依然伴随着我们。

sentences.en: It's still out there and we still have to be aware of it
sentences.zh: 它依然存在，我们仍然需要意识到它，

sentences.en: and we still have to raise money and we still have to fight it
sentences.zh: 我们仍然需要筹集资金，我们仍然需要与之斗争，

sentences.en: and we still have to care for people and so on and so forth.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然需要关爱人们，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Now, AIDS isn't the killer that it used to be, at least in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 如今，艾滋病已不像过去那样致命了，至少在美国是这样。

sentences.en: But that doesn't mean the disease is gone.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着这种疾病已经消失。

sentences.en: The number of people living with HIV in the United States
sentences.zh: 美国感染 HIV 的总人数

sentences.en: is now higher than ever before.
sentences.zh: 现在比以往任何时候都要高。

sentences.en: Patrick O'Connell also says he'll keep wearing his AIDS awareness ribbons.
sentences.zh: 帕特里克·奥康奈尔也表示他会继续佩戴他的艾滋病意识丝带。

sentences.en: Back at his apartment, he showed me the ribbons in his wardrobe.
sentences.zh: 回到他的公寓，他向我展示了他的衣柜里的那些丝带。

sentences.en: Sure, they're on stuff still.
sentences.zh: 当然，它们依然挂在各种东西上。

sentences.en: There must be 30 ribbons there, I feel like.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那里一定有 30 条丝带。

sentences.en: Yeah, they're probably a bag of 100 in there somewhere.
sentences.zh: 是的，某个地方可能还放着一整包 100 条的丝带呢。

sentences.en: He doesn't even take them off when he washes his shirts.
sentences.zh: 他洗衬衫时甚至都不会把它们摘下来。

sentences.en: He just keeps them pinned on.
sentences.zh: 他就一直把它们别在上面。

sentences.en: Is there anything I haven't asked you about the ribbon you'd want me to ask?
sentences.zh: 关于丝带，有什么我没问到而你希望我问的吗？

sentences.en: Well, you didn't ask if we had fun.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你没问我们当时过得开心吗。

sentences.en: We did.
sentences.zh: 我们确实很开心。

sentences.en: Bizarrely, we had fun.
sentences.zh: 说来奇怪，我们过得很开心。

sentences.en: I'm telling you, fun.
sentences.zh: 我跟你说，真的非常开心。

sentences.en: Give my regards to Broadway.
sentences.zh: 代我向百老汇问好。

sentences.en: Remember me to Harrow Square.
sentences.zh: 请代我问候哈罗广场。

sentences.en: Tell all the folks on 42nd Street that I will soon be there.
sentences.zh: 告诉第四街的所有人，我很快就会去那里。

sentences.en: Tell them of how I'm yearning to mingle with the old-time throng.
sentences.zh: 告诉他们我是多么渴望与老朋友们相聚。

sentences.en: Give my regards to old Broadway and say that I'll be there and...
sentences.zh: 代我向老百老汇问好，并说我将会去那里，还有……

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Audrey Quinn
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%无形》由奥黛丽·奎恩制作，

sentences.en: with Katie Mingle, Sam Greenspan, Avery Truffleman, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 合作者包括凯蒂·明格、萨姆·格林斯潘、艾弗里·特鲁夫曼以及我，罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: We are a project of KALW San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山 KALW 的一个项目，

sentences.en: and produced out of the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 制作于 ArcSign 的办公室，

sentences.en: an architecture and interiors firm
sentences.zh: 这是一家建筑与室内设计公司，

sentences.en: in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 位于加利福尼亚州美丽的奥克兰市中心。

sentences.en: The inspiration for this story came from WHYY's The Pulse,
sentences.zh: 这个故事的灵感来自 WHYY 的《脉搏》，

sentences.en: where you can also hear Audrey's story about the history of the breast cancer ribbon.
sentences.zh: 在那里你也可以听到奥黛丽关于乳腺癌丝带历史的故事。

sentences.en: We'll link to The Pulse on our website.
sentences.zh: 我们会在我们的网站上提供通往《脉搏》的链接。

sentences.en: You can find this show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Facebook 上找到并点赞本节目。

sentences.en: We're all on Twitter, and you can follow me at Roman Mars
sentences.zh: 我们都在 Twitter 上，如果你想看我因为妻子离家而度过抓狂的一周，

sentences.en: if you want to watch me devolve over the week as my wife is away.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Twitter 上关注我 @Roman Mars。

sentences.en: We also have a Tumblr with cool stuff every single day.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一个 Tumblr，每天都有酷炫的内容。

sentences.en: But more info on this story and the entire 99PI catalog can be found
sentences.zh: 关于这个故事的更多信息以及 99PI 的全部节目目录，

sentences.en: at 99PI.org.
sentences.zh: 请访问 99PI.org。

sentences.en: Radiotopia.
sentences.zh: 放射乌托邦。
